title: Energy, Work and Power Module 4 Lesson 1: Driving Force Acceleration Level Road custom practice

evidence_basis.originality_note: All prompts, numerical values and physical configurations are original; mapped Cambridge past-paper evidence informs cognitive demand and assessment structure only.

parts.prompt: A cyclist of mass $75\text{ kg}$ (including bicycle) accelerates at $0.4\text{ m s}^{-2}$ along a straight horizontal road against a constant resistance of $20\text{ N}$. Find the power developed by the cyclist at the instant when her speed is $5\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

A car of mass $1100\text{ kg}$ moves along a straight level road. The engine operates at a power of $33\text{ kW}$ and the resistance to motion is $700\text{ N}$. Find the acceleration of the car at an instant when its speed is $15\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

A van of mass $2500\text{ kg}$ is travelling along a straight horizontal road. When its speed is $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$, the engine works at $45\text{ kW}$ and the van's acceleration is $0.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$. Find the magnitude of the resistance to motion.

A car of mass $1400\text{ kg}$ travels along a level road at $18\text{ m s}^{-1}$. The resistance to motion is $650\text{ N}$. Calculate the engine power in $\text{kW}$ required for the car to accelerate at $1.25\text{ m s}^{-2}$ at this instant.

A sports car of mass $1200\text{ kg}$ operates at a constant power of $60\text{ kW}$ on a horizontal test track against a constant resistance of $800\text{ N}$. Find the acceleration of the car when its speed is $25\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

A lorry of mass $8000\text{ kg}$ is travelling at $24\text{ m s}^{-1}$ on a horizontal road when the driver takes their foot off the accelerator, reducing the driving force to zero. The resistance to motion is a constant $1600\text{ N}$. Calculate the deceleration of the lorry and the distance it travels before coming to rest.

questions.prompt: A car of mass $1200\text{ kg}$ is travelling along a straight horizontal road. There is a constant resistance to motion of magnitude $600\text{ N}$. When the car is travelling at $16\text{ m s}^{-1}$, its acceleration is $0.75\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the driving force exerted by the engine and the power of the engine in $\text{kW}$ at this instant.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: If the engine continues to work at this constant power of $24\text{ kW}$, find the maximum possible speed the car can reach on this horizontal road.

questions.prompt: An electric vehicle of mass $1500\text{ kg}$ travels along a straight level road. The resistance to motion is constant and equal to $750\text{ N}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: When travelling at a steady speed of $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$, find the power developed by the motor in $\text{kW}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: The driver steps on the accelerator, instantly increasing the motor power to $45\text{ kW}$ while the speed is still $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$. Find the initial acceleration of the vehicle immediately after this power increase.

questions.prompt: A car of mass $1600\text{ kg}$ is towing a trailer of mass $400\text{ kg}$ along a straight horizontal road. The car and trailer are connected by a light rigid horizontal towbar. The resistance to motion is $300\text{ N}$ on the car and $150\text{ N}$ on the trailer. At an instant when the speed of the car is $18\text{ m s}^{-1}$, the car and trailer are accelerating at $1.2\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Calculate the tension in the towbar at this instant.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the driving force exerted by the car's engine and the power developed by the engine in $\text{kW}$ at this instant.

questions.prompt: A delivery van of mass $2400\text{ kg}$ moves along a straight level road with its engine working at a constant power of $48\text{ kW}$. A constant resistance of $1200\text{ N}$ opposes the motion.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of the van when its speed is $16\text{ m s}^{-1}$, and find the acceleration when its speed has increased to $24\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: The van reaches a speed of $32\text{ m s}^{-1}$. Calculate the driving force and acceleration at $32\text{ m s}^{-1}$, and determine the maximum speed the van can achieve on the level road.

questions.prompt: A truck of mass $6000\text{ kg}$ accelerates from a speed of $12\text{ m s}^{-1}$ to a speed of $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$ along a straight level road. The engine works at a constant rate of $75\text{ kW}$ and the resistance to motion is constant at $1500\text{ N}$. The time taken for this speed increase is $14\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Calculate the driving force and acceleration of the truck at the instant its speed is $15\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Calculate the increase in kinetic energy of the truck, the total work done by the engine during the $14\text{ s}$, and the distance travelled by the truck in this time.

questions.prompt: A sports car of mass $1400\text{ kg}$ travels along a straight level road. The resistance to motion is given by $R = (400 + 30v)\,\text{N}$, where $v\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ is the speed of the car. The car's engine develops a constant power of $70\text{ kW}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of the car when its speed is $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$, and show that the maximum speed $V$ of the car satisfies the equation $3V^2 + 40V - 7000 = 0$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Solve the quadratic equation to find the maximum speed of the car to 3 significant figures, and calculate the driving force exerted by the engine at this maximum speed.

questions.prompt: A breakdown truck of mass $3000\text{ kg}$ is towing a broken-down van of mass $1800\text{ kg}$ along a straight horizontal road. The towbar is horizontal and rigid. The engine of the truck works at a constant power of $54\text{ kW}$. A constant resistance of $600\text{ N}$ acts on the truck and a constant resistance of $400\text{ N}$ acts on the van.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: At an instant when the speed of the vehicles is $15\text{ m s}^{-1}$, calculate the driving force of the truck, the acceleration of the combination, and the tension in the towbar.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: At this same speed of $15\text{ m s}^{-1}$, the towbar suddenly breaks. Assuming the truck's engine power remains at $54\text{ kW}$ and the resistance on each vehicle is unchanged, find the instantaneous acceleration of the truck immediately after the break, and calculate the distance the van rolls along the horizontal road before coming to rest.
